WITH cv AS ( SELECT emd_cd, lat, lot, COUNT(*) AS n FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND ocrn_dt >= #{cvFrom} AND ocrn_dt < #{cvToExcl} AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY emd_cd, lat, lot), c AS ( SELECT emd_cd, SUM(n) AS cvlcpt_cnt,
COALESCE(MAX(n) FILTER (WHERE lat IS NOT NULL AND lot IS NOT NULL), 0) AS top_pnt_cvlcpt_cnt FROM cv GROUP BY emd_cd), cvt AS ( SELECT emd_cd, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ocrn_dt >= #{trendFrom,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND ocrn_dt < #{cvFrom}) AS bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ocrn_dt >= #{cvFrom} AND ocrn_dt < #{splitMid,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP}) AS half_bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ocrn_dt >= #{splitMidExcl,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND ocrn_dt < #{cvToExcl}) AS half_aftr_cvlcpt_cnt FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND ocrn_dt >= #{trendFrom,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP} AND ocrn_dt < #{cvToExcl} AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL GROUP BY emd_cd), s AS ( SELECT emd_cd, COUNT(*) AS pklt_cnt, COALESCE(SUM(pklt_cpcty), 0) AS pklt_cpcty,
COALESCE(SUM(pklt_cpcty) FILTER (WHERE pklt_type_cd IS DISTINCT FROM 'VACLOT'), 0) AS vaclot_excl_pklt_cpcty FROM parking.tb_pblpklt WHERE extsh_dt IS NULL GROUP BY emd_cd) SELECT a.emd_cd, a.sgg_nm, a.emd_nm, a.ctr_lat AS lat, a.ctr_lot AS lot, COALESCE(c.cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS cvlcpt_cnt, COALESCE(c.top_pnt_cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS top_pnt_cvlcpt_cnt, COALESCE(cvt.bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, COALESCE(cvt.half_bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS half_bfr_cvlcpt_cnt, COALESCE(cvt.half_aftr_cvlcpt_cnt, 0) AS half_aftr_cvlcpt_cnt, COALESCE(s.pklt_cnt, 0) AS pklt_cnt, COALESCE(s.pklt_cpcty, 0) AS pklt_cpcty, COALESCE(s.vaclot_excl_pklt_cpcty, 0) AS vaclot_excl_pklt_cpcty FROM parking.tb_admdst a LEFT JOIN c ON c.emd_cd = a.emd_cd LEFT JOIN cvt ON cvt.emd_cd = a.emd_cd LEFT JOIN s ON s.emd_cd = a.emd_cd ORDER BY a.emd_cd
SELECT to_char(min(ocrn_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_bgng_ymd, to_char(max(ocrn_dt), 'YYYYMMDD') AS data_end_ymd FROM parking.tb_cvlcpt WHERE cvlcpt_type_cd <> '99' AND emd_cd IS NOT NULL
